name: IDFC FIRST Bank MBA Scholarship Program (2026-28 batch)

rules.quote: Open for Indian Nationals, residing in India only
Gross annual family income from all sources should be less than or equal to ₹6 Lakhs p.a.*

rules.value: first year of two-year full-time MBA or equivalent, class of 2026-28
rules.quote: Applicable for students enrolled in first year of the two-year MBA program or its equivalent of the class of 2026 – 2028

rules.value: only MBA colleges on the bank's eligible list (255 colleges)
rules.quote: Enrolled in any of the MBA colleges mentioned in the below list
The applicant must have a valid mobile number linked to Aadhaar card

amount.text: Rs 2,00,000 over two years (Rs 1 lakh p.a.); 700 scholarships
amount.quote: INR 2,00,000 for two years of full-time MBA studies ( 1 Lakh p.a. subject to T&C)

documents.name: Income certificate or ITR intimation u/s 143(1)
documents.quote: Income Certificate or intimation u/s 143(1) document of earning members.

documents.name: Admission letter (first year MBA)
documents.quote: Admission letter of enrolment into first year of two-year full-time MBA program

documents.name: Fee payment receipt
documents.quote: Confirmation letter of Fees paid to the college/ Fee Payment receipt.

deadline.text: Applications for 2026-28 batch closed; results last week of October
deadline.quote: Applications for the MBA Scholarship Program (2026-28 Batch) are now closed.
